gloss: game of tag; game of chase

definitions.gloss: game of tag; game of chase
definitions.explanation: A children's chasing game, or any reciprocal chasing activity. Formed from {追|お}いかける (to chase) + the suffix っこ that turns the verb into a playful reciprocal action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{追|お}いかけっこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We played tag in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{追|お}いかけっこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I played chase with the puppy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}って→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧{追|お}いかけっこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The two siblings are running around the yard playing tag.

notes:
Verb + っこ is a productive pattern forming reciprocal/competitive activity nouns (にらめっこ staring contest, ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧っこ tug-of-war for an item, etc.). Has a childlike, casual feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追|お}いかけっこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play tag
- {追|お}いかけっこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play chase

USAGE:
Can describe a back-and-forth competitive situation: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追|お}いかけっこ (a sales race between competitors), ⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追|お}いかけっこ (a race for first place).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鬼|おに}ごっこ→鬼ごっこ：06321_onigokko⟧: tag (with a designated 'it'/⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧) — a specific named version of {追|お}いかけっこ
